comparison.objective: Pose two friction-jointed helping hands so wire ends cross over a mark.
comparison.physical_skill: Articulated fixture adjustment and fine two-end spatial alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Released wire ends meet overlap, lateral-gap, and mark-distance limits without slipping or dropped parts.
comparison.reason: Fine positioning of two passive arms and wires does not test load-bearing insertion, spring retention, telescoping, or fastening.
